subject: Risk & Compliance
title: DeFi and Regulatory Gaps
description: A 60-second lesson on DeFi and Regulatory Gaps.

hook.text: Decentralized finance has no company to regulate. Smart contracts run on code. Who do you fine?

buildup.text: DeFi protocols let users lend, borrow, and trade without intermediaries. There's no bank to enforce KYC.

discovery.text: The Tornado Cash mixer was sanctioned by OFAC in 2022. Its developer was arrested in the Netherlands.

twist.text: Sanctioning code raises legal questions. Is open-source software a person, a tool, or a crime?

climax.text: DeFi forces regulators to rethink who is responsible when there's no company, no CEO, and no office.

punchline.text: No company. No CEO. Just code. Who's responsible?

quiz.question: Why is DeFi hard to regulate?
options: There's no intermediary company to hold accountable
DeFi only operates in one country
All DeFi platforms already comply with AML rules
